# Extract the relevant columns for analysis
education_expenditure = adjusted_savings_df.drop(columns=['Country Group', 'Country Code']).values
gni_per_capita = gni_per_capita_df.drop(columns=['Country Group', 'Country Code']).values
exports_growth = exports_df.drop(columns=['Country Group', 'Country Code']).values

# Check the shape of the data
education_expenditure.shape, gni_per_capita.shape, exports_growth.shape

from sklearn.linear_model import LinearRegression
import numpy as np

# Prepare the data for regression
# Reshape the data to 2D arrays for each year
years = np.arange(1975, 2016)

# Create a list of years for each dataset
education_expenditure_2d = np.reshape(education_expenditure, (2, 41))
gni_per_capita_2d = np.reshape(gni_per_capita, (2, 41))
exports_growth_2d = np.reshape(exports_growth, (2, 41))

# Initialize a list to store the regression results
regression_results = []

# Perform regression for each year
for year in years:
    # Extract the data for the current year
    X = np.column_stack((education_expenditure_2d[:, year - 1975], gni_per_capita_2d[:, year - 1975]))
    y = exports_growth_2d[:, year - 1975]

    # Create a linear regression model
    model = LinearRegression()
    model.fit(X, y)

    # Get the coefficients and p-values
    coefficients = model.coef_
    p_values = np.array([0.05, 0.05])  # Placeholder for p-values

    # Store the results
    regression_results.append({
        'Year': year,
        'Education Expenditure Coefficient': coefficients[0],
        'GNI per Capita Coefficient': coefficients[1],
        'P-value (Education Expenditure)': p_values[0],
        'P-value (GNI per Capita)': p_values[1]
    })

# Convert the results to a DataFrame
regression_results_df = pd.DataFrame(regression_results)
regression_results_df

import statsmodels.api as sm

# Initialize a list to store the regression results
regression_results = []

# Perform regression for each year
for year in years:
    # Extract the data for the current year
    X = np.column_stack((education_expenditure_2d_imputed[:, year - 1975], gni_per_capita_2d_imputed[:, year - 1975]))
    y = exports_growth_2d_imputed[:, year - 1975]

    # Add a constant to the model (intercept)
    X = sm.add_constant(X)

    # Create a linear regression model
    model = sm.OLS(y, X).fit()

    # Get the coefficients and p-values
    coefficients = model.params
    p_values = model.pvalues

    # Store the results
    regression_results.append({
        'Year': year,
        'Education Expenditure Coefficient': coefficients[1],
        'GNI per Capita Coefficient': coefficients[2],
        'P-value (Education Expenditure)': p_values[1],
        'P-value (GNI per Capita)': p_values[2]
    })

# Convert the results to a DataFrame
regression_results_df = pd.DataFrame(regression_results)
